name: LineageOS 21
details:
LineageOS 21 for Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby)

This is a stable build of LineageOS 21 for the Redmi Note 12 Pro 5G (ruby), based on Android 14.

Changelog:

  • Update Android version to 14 (based on LineageOS 21)
  • Update blobs from MIUI V14.0.6.0.TMOMIXM
  • Upstream kernel to 4.19.300 (ASB-2023-12-05_4.19-stable)
  • December 5th 2023 Security Patch
  • November 1st 2023 Vendor Security Patch
  • Numerous UI optimizations
  • Switch back to power-libperfmgr
  • Set proper side fingerprint location
  • Enable FUSE passthrough by default
  • Reworked CarrierConfig, IMS features are no longer force enabled but instead only shown if your carrier actually supports them.
  • Add dynamic sensors HAL support
  • Add (untested) support for IFAA payments

Bugs:

  • There is currently a visual bug with the volume panel.

Notes:

  • Only use MIUI 14 firmware based on Android 13 (V14.0.6.0.TMOMIXM strongly recommended)
  • Dolby Atmos and MIUI Camera are included.
  • Aux lenses do not work on the first MIUI Camera start, a restart fixes them forever.
  • If you run into issues, please be prepared to send a detailed bug report to the developer, including instructions to reproduce and provide logcats as well.
  • Lineage Recovery (attached below, as boot.img) MUST BE USED TO FLASH THE ROM.
